films.title: The Golden Touch
films.description: Disney's Silly Symphony restages the golden touch as a cartoon caution — Midas starving amid gold he cannot eat.

popCulture.title: Midas touch
popCulture.description: English still calls a gift for making money the Midas touch — the Phrygian king's blessing rewritten as a business compliment.

popCulture.title: Midas
popCulture.description: The king who wished everything gold remains the emblem of desire that backfires — donkey ears, the Pactolus, and a lesson in enough.
